stonedfenicsx.utils.check_race_condition(ioctrl: stonedfenicsx.config.numerical_control.IOControls, file: str) → bool[source]¶

Check whether the temporary cache file is held open by another process.

Iterates over all running processes via psutil. Returns True if any process has the cache file open, False otherwise. Processes that have died or are inaccessible between iteration and inspection are silently skipped.

Args: ioctrl (IOControls): I/O control object providing path_cached_information.

Returns: bool: True if the file is currently open by another process, False if safe to write.
